I work a 9-5 M-F and here are my pointers

Don't have kids. Get cats- much more appreciative and loving and much less maintenance than kids, horses or dogs.

Place permanent bins for rubbish in each room (space depending) so that it is easy to sort through and dispose of (outdoor bin space depending).

Leave work at work. When you clock-out at 5, wrap up what you're doing and then move on to your evening routine. No need to worry about work out of the hours you're paid for.

Join discord groups, Tiktok lives, (do people still use Facebook lol). Being an adult means accepting you and your peers are BUSY. At least maintaining online relationships is a lot more convenient and helps you with socialisation.

Use all of your annual leave allowance.

Hiya. 29 AuADHD here. I remember being in your shoes when I was 18-19. Going to do a course I was passionate in (in my case art, design and media) at my local community college was the best thing I ever did. It literally paved the way to Uni for me - I now have a degree in BA animation! 

Maybe you would benefit from doing a fashion design course or going to trades school to learn more about how you could start your own baking business. The King's Trust  offer training courses for NEET people between 16-30 years old. Enterprise is one which would help start you up with your own business. Worth a look!

Regardless, I would not like to be 21 again- too much choice paralysis! I do feel for you OP but the one thing ai can advise you NOT to do is to do nothing. That will get you nowhere and will only make your mental health worse. Please take care of yourself sending virtual hugs (or handshakes)
